<hbox align="center">
            <label
              data-l10n-id="outgoing-server-name"
              control="identity.smtpServerKey"
            />
            <menulist
              wsm_persist="true"
              id="identity.smtpServerKey"
              flex="1"
              pref="true"
              preftype="string"
              prefattribute="value"
              prefstring="mail.identity.%identitykey%.smtpServer"
            >
              <menupopup id="smtpPopup">
                <menuitem
                  value=""
                  label="&smtpDefaultServer.label;"
                  id="useDefaultItem"
                />
                <menuseparator />
                <!-- list will be inserted here -->
              </menupopup>
            </menulist>
